verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents dedicated endpoints as reserved, provisioned instances not shared with other customers, supporting the core isolation-from-shared-pool need, and supports deploying custom fine-tuned models on these endpoints. However, there is no evidence of autoscaling behavior for dedicated capacity — the docs describe a fixed provisioned/reserved instance model rather than an autoscaling deployment mechanism. missing for 10: explicit autoscaling/elastic-capacity documentation for dedicated endpoints, independent verification of dedicated endpoint behavior under variable load.
